question:
Choose the correct meaning of idiom:
Fiddle while Rome burns

options.text: To waste time in trivialities during a crisis

solution: The correct answer is: **Option 2**, i.e., "To waste time in trivialities during a crisis". [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"Fiddle while Rome burns"** means to waste time on unimportant matters while ignoring a significant or urgent crisis. (एक बड़े संकट के दौरान महत्वहीन चीजों में समय बर्बाद करना) • **Example:** The manager was busy planning a party while the company was facing major financial losses. Truly, he fiddled while Rome burned. • This idiom originates from the legend of Emperor Nero, who allegedly played the fiddle while Rome was burning in a great fire. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Option 1: To play music at night **(रात में संगीत बजाना): This option refers to playing musical instruments during nighttime, which is unrelated to the idiom's meaning. • **Example:** He often plays the guitar at night to relax after work. • **Option 3: To seek artistic approval **(कलात्मक स्वीकृति प्राप्त करना): This means to look for recognition or validation of one's creative or artistic work. • **Example:** The artist sought artistic approval by showcasing his work in galleries. • **Option 4: To incite rebellion **(विद्रोह को भड़काना): This means to provoke or encourage people to rebel against authority. • **Example:** The leader's fiery speeches were aimed at inciting rebellion among the oppressed workers. 35:Ta7f, The correct answer is: **Defend**.
